castOption.label: Origami Angel/Demon
castOption.note: In your Origami Angel/Demon state: Self (30-foot cone), every ally in it.

system.description:
You take chakra infused paper and direct it to a wounded ally, as it binds itself to them, usually over an open wound attempting to both apply pressure and Sucher it closed. Select one willing creature within range with less than full hit points, as they regain 3d6 hit points and make a Constitution saving throw vs a DC 20, removing 1 rank of a Physical condition they have on a success.

Origami Angel/Demon. If this jutsu is cast while in your Origami Angel/Demon state this jutsu’s range becomes Self (30-foot cone), applying to all allied creatures in range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the hit points healed by 1d6.
